'''Borgin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he asked an Imperial to defeat a group of Republic ambushers that was preying on Imperial convoys.<ref name="TOR" />
